Guidance: Unique identifier for the issue (e.g., ISS-01).
Type or classification of the issue (e.g., Technical, Resource, Schedule).
Origin or root trigger of the issue (e.g., Vendor delay, Requirement change).
Detailed explanation of the issue and current condition.
Urgency or priority level (e.g., Urgent, High, Medium, Low).
Potential or realized impact on scope, schedule, cost, or quality.
Stakeholders or user groups affected by this issue.
The person or role assigned to resolve or track the issue.
Current status of the issue (e.g., Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed).
Target or actual date by which the issue was resolved.
Summary of the corrective action taken to resolve the issue.
Additional notes, context, or escalation details.
